ModMetaData.name: Better Food Policy
ModMetaData.author: 9ranr11d
ModMetaData.description:
Better quality-of-life tools for food policies and food poisoning.
Features: - Carry amount per food in food policies, like the drug policy's carry column. - Food poisoning source reveal: when someone gets food poisoning, only the food made in the same batch is marked, left uneaten, and can be burned.
